title: Memory corruption in CacheStorage in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker… (CVE-2026-76027)
description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the CacheStorage component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw allows a remote attacker to read memory by crafting a malicious HTML page. The vulnerability has been assigned a high severity by the Chromium security team.
